description: Defines thread management functionalities including thread creation, priority, affinity, thread-local storage, and thread sampling for the Starboard platform. Contains enums, typedefs, and function declarations related to thread operations.

methods.name: SbThreadGetId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the currently executing thread.

methods.name: SbThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority of the current thread (API version >= 16).

methods.name: SbThreadGetPriority
methods.description: Gets the thread priority of the current thread (API version >= 16).

methods.name: SbThreadCreate
methods.description: Creates a new thread with specified parameters including stack size, priority, affinity, joinability, name, entry point, and context.

methods.name: SbThreadJoin
methods.description: Joins a thread, blocking until it exits and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: SbThreadDetach
methods.description: Detaches a thread, making it non-joinable.

methods.name: SbThreadYield
methods.description: Yields execution of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadSleep
methods.description: Sleeps the current thread for a specified duration in microseconds.

methods.name: SbThreadGetCurrent
methods.description: Returns the handle of the currently executing thread.

methods.name: SbThreadIsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two thread handles refer to the same thread.

methods.name: SbThreadGetName
methods.description: Retrieves the debug name of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadSetName
methods.description: Sets the debug name of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadCreateLocalKey
methods.description: Creates a new thread-local storage key with an optional destructor.

methods.name: SbThreadDestroyLocalKey
methods.description: Destroys a thread-local storage key.

methods.name: SbThreadGetLocalValue
methods.description: Retrieves the thread-local value for a given key.

methods.name: SbThreadSetLocalValue
methods.description: Sets the thread-local value for a given key.

methods.name: SbThreadContextGetPointer
methods.description: Retrieves a specific pointer property from a thread context.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if thread sampling is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerCreate
methods.description: Creates a thread sampler for a specified thread.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a thread sampler.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerFreeze
methods.description: Freezes a thread, returning its context.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerThaw
methods.description: Resumes a frozen thread, invalidating its context.
